title: Interactive model pinboard: pin/unpin across routes and surface performance snapshots
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Introduce an Interactive Model Pinboard feature inside the Console that lets engineers and PMs select and pin model versions at multiple scopes (org, project, route), preview published performance profiles, and quickly diff version performance & cost. Goal: reduce onboarding friction for new model variants and make version pinning explicit and auditable in the Console UI. This ticket scopes product requirements, acceptance criteria, and design handoff for an initial MVP that supports pin/unpin, quick-preview of latency/cost/quality metrics, and a lightweight publish flow for performance profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open a Model Pinboard from a model or route page and see all available model versions with published performance profiles.
Users can pin a specific version at three scopes: Org default, Project default, Route override. Pinning updates are reflected in the Console and emit an audit event.
Pin action surfaces a confirmation modal that shows projected median latency, 95th latency, token cost delta, and recent eval score for the selected version.
Published performance profile snapshots are shown with timestamp and commit/hash metadata and can be previewed without leaving the pin flow.

Users can select two versions and open a side-by-side diff overlay that highlights differences in latency, cost per 1k tokens, and a selected quality metric (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE/Custom eval), with a simple recommendation helper (lower latency, lower cost tradeoff guidance).
All pin/unpin actions generate a lightweight audit log entry visible in the route activity feed and available via API for compliance customers.
Design assets (Figma) and handoff spec are attached; engineering acceptance tests and e2e checklist are provided before close.
tasks: Draft UX flows for Model Pinboard (desktop + tablet) and annotate edge states
Define and document the scope model for pinning scoping rules (org/project/route precedence)
Create API contract for pin/unpin and profile snapshot fetch endpoints with ENG
Design confirmation and diff overlays; produce Figma frames for handoff
Implement audit event schema and add to activity feed + API
Add backend gating to ensure only published profiles are selectable in pin flow
QA: e2e tests for pin/unpin, preview gallery, diff overlay, and audit events
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Khan: Initial draft of the product requirements posted. Primary goal is to make version selection explicit in the Console and avoid silent rollouts. See linked Figma prototype (WIP).

2026-03-04 - Diego Martinez: Spoke with ENG about API shape. ENG prefers a single POST /pins with scope param. They flagged the need for optimistic locking when multiple admins pin at same time (ENG-2219).
2026-03-06 - Maria Lopez (Design): Uploaded first Figma frames: pinboard grid, detail flyout, diff overlay. Added states for 'no published profile' and 'profile stale'.

2026-03-08 - Product review: PM/Design/ENG alignment. Decision: MVP will only support published performance profiles (no ad-hoc metrics). We'll add a lightweight recommendation helper in the diff overlay that scores tradeoffs numerically.

2026-03-10 - Security review (initial): Security asked to confirm audit events include user id and IP. For privacy, we won't store full IP—hash prefix only. Not blocking, requires compliance note in spec.
2026-03-12 - QA note: Need to test cross-region pin precedence when dedicated capacity has region-specific variants. Added as dependency to ENG-2293.

2026-03-14 - Diego Martinez: Updated API contract link and added a small scope change: include model build_id in profile metadata so we can always tie a profile back to CI artifacts. Linked GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/478
